# get_energy_interpolator { #mofography.compute.get_energy_interpolator }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> Linear scipy interpolator on egrid; tricubic is preferred for screening accuracy. Use `get_energy_interpolator_tricubic` instead.

```python
compute.get_energy_interpolator(
    egrid,
    neighborhood_size=4,
    extent_x=1.0,
    extent_y=1.0,
    extent_z=1.0,
)
```

Build a scipy RegularGridInterpolator for a 3D energy grid, filling NaNs from local neighborhoods.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type   | Description                                                                      | Default    |
|-------------------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| egrid             |        | a 3D numpy array representing a grid of energy values with shape (n_x, n_y, n_z) | _required_ |
| neighborhood_size |        | size of neighborhood to check in each direction (default: 4)                     | `4`        |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                             |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | a RegularGridInterpolator object for the 3D energy grid |
